[squad_p_895a99d78539698b] The program also allowed students and faculty members from these schools to attend the University of Chicago for free and receive credit for their work. [squad_p_895a99d78539698b] However, the program was not well-received by some University of Chicago professors who felt it involved uncompensated additional labor and cheapened the academic reputation of the university. [squad_p_895a99d78539698b] The program passed into history by 1910. [squad_p_895a99d78539698b]
